title: Invertibility of the normalized geometric coefficient mate
statement:
Given source and target Data and a GeometryOrdinary realization, the left mate of the canonically localized coefficient-restriction/pullback square is an isomorphism for every actual transition n ≤ m. No coefficient flatness or K-injective evaluation hypothesis is assumed.

The sites, coefficient tower and fixed ordinary realization are as in lem-coef-semilinear-geometric-derived-evaluation. The precise Lean statement, with the ambient parameter context, is:

universe c v r
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Opposite
namespace WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)
  {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
  (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
  (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
  (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
  (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)variable (A : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ)
  (O : GeometryOrdinary.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet)
  (target : Data.{c, v, r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)
theorem geometricCoefficientPullbackMate_isIso [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    IsIso ((mateEquiv (A.scalar h).adjunction (target.scalar h).adjunction).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (O.restrictionPullback h) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).hom))).natTrans

proof.text: Construct the underlying ring natural transformation using NatTrans.ofOpSequence from the adjacent coefficient compatibility. Its naturality gives the coefficient square for every composite transition.

Apply exists_scalarInverseImageIndependent to the two actual ordinary scalar adjunctions. Transpose the inverse restriction comparison. Faithfulness of the underlying module-sheaf functor, naturality of moduleUnderlying, restrictionPullback_underlying and the supplied scalar unit equation identify the ordinary mate with the inverse of that isomorphism.

Inverse image carries flat-term K-flat complexes to flat-term K-flat complexes: use the existing ringed-topos pullback theorem with the identity structural coefficient map and remove its identity extension using the normalized identity scalar model.

On a common K-flat representative, apply the two ScalarData.transpose_model equations and the mate transpose identity. The exact-localization compositor identifies the derived restriction square with its cochain map. The derived mate is consequently conjugate to the ordinary scalar mate by invertible model comparisons.
Resolve an arbitrary cochain complex by a flat-term K-flat complex. Naturality transports invertibility from its localized representative to every derived object.
